comments.text: Hey Cory, vfx artist here, my best guess for the last video is that it's fully 3d rendered animation. The already uncanny VHS style makes it much easier to make stuff look realistic, and so does having it in the dark except for a flashlight. The camera movements also probably play a big part in how real it feels, and I imagine they were done by filming with a real camera, tracking the footage captured, and then bringing that into whatever 3d software was used. It's a pretty common technique for getting natural handheld motion in animations. I could be wrong, but one of the biggest reasons i think its full animation is the way the hand moves. It's VERY close to being natural, but it still a little glidey (though still very skillful).
